filing_deadline_basis: Date of initial determination (notice of non-coverage or MSN)
submission_address_notes: Submit to the MAC that processed the original claim. Address printed on the Medicare Summary Notice (MSN) or Explanation of Medicare Benefits (EOMB).
Submit to the QIC identified in the MAC's redetermination notice. QIC assignment varies by jurisdiction.

decision_maker: Office of Medicare Hearings and Appeals (OMHA) Administrative Law Judge
submission_address_notes: Amount in controversy (AIC) threshold applies — CMS publishes updated dollar amount annually. Verify current threshold before advising member. File with OMHA.

decision_maker: Departmental Appeals Board (DAB) Medicare Appeals Council
submission_address_notes: File with the Medicare Appeals Council at the Departmental Appeals Board (DAB). No additional AIC threshold beyond L3.

filing_deadline_basis: Date of Medicare Appeals Council decision
submission_address_notes: File in the U.S. District Court for the district where the enrollee resides or does business. AIC threshold applies (CMS-annual) — verify current amount before advising member.

decision_maker: Medicare Advantage plan (organization determination and internal appeal process)
filing_deadline_basis: Plan-specific — refer to plan EOB and Evidence of Coverage (EOC)
submission_address_notes: Submit to the MA plan that issued the adverse organization determination. Contact information and deadlines are in the plan's Evidence of Coverage (EOC). MA plans must offer an equivalent 5-level process but routing is plan-specific.
citation: 42 CFR §422.562–§422.622; CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual, Ch. 13
